aspect: EXAMPLE - a collective found the Jalisco ranch
description: Rancho Izaguirre in Teuchitlán was uncovered on 5 March 2025 by Guerreros Buscadores, a civilian collective of families searching for missing people - not by any state agency.
energy_note: Volunteers found it. Not the state.

description: Members of search collectives have been murdered for searching. The work is done by relatives because it is not done otherwise, and it carries the same risk that produced the disappearance.
energy_note: Killed for looking for her son.

aspect: The inversion this dataset is built on
description: The disappeared are overwhelmingly men; the people searching are overwhelmingly women. The violence is gendered in both directions at once and the two facts belong together.
energy_note: Men vanish; women look for them.
notes: Cross-reference to assets/text/nigeria and palestine, which hold the women-first view of the same structures.

description: She pushes a steel rod into the ground and pulls it out and smells it. That is the method. She has done this on seventy Saturdays. The state prosecutor's office has sent someone twice.
energy_note: Seventy Saturdays, and a smell on a metal rod.
